server account or make it the default](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-or-make-it-th
e-default.md): Rename the account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses
answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_taken\"`.\n- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/i
mport-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads
to your default account on the server, creating an unnamed one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts
API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Sunse…\n- [List GitHub Checks repositories](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/evals/list-github-checks-repositories.md): The repositories in this organization whose pull requests run an eval suite,
plus the repositories the MCPJam GitHub App can reach (the choices a connect has).\n- [Run an eval suite on a repository's pull r
equests](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/run-an-eval-suite-on-a-repositorys-pull-requests.md): Connect a repository so
every pull request to it runs one eval suite and reports a GitHub check. **Affects everyone who opens a pull request on that repo
sitory**, and with `outagePolicy: fail_closed` it can block their merges.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a
model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n- [G
rade an eval run with LLM as Judge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spends.
** Runs the goal-completion judge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.\n- [Create
a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's organization and
responds `201` with its detail. Requires organization membership and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit. Guest callers
are denied.\n- [Delete a project and everything scoped to it](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/delete-a-project-and
-everything-scoped-to-it.md): IRREVERSIBLE, and it cascades: project access grants and invites, the mapped workspace and its membe
rships, every saved server in the project (each soft-deleted asynchronously, which also rotates the host configs that referenced i
t), and hosted tasks. Requires project admin. The request body must be…\n- [Update project metadata](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/projects/update-project-metadata.md): Updates name, description, icon or visibility. Requires project admin; a non-member
gets `404` rather than `403`, so the response never confirms that a project exists. The project's server map is not updatable her
e — see the per-server routes.\n- [What the caller may do here](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/what-the-caller-may
-do-here.md): Role, gate state, plan limits and a set of derived booleans — so an agent on a static surface can check before it ac
ts instead of attempting a write and reading the failure.\n- [Save a server into a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md): Creates a saved MCP server and responds `201` with its detail. This is the provisioning
entry point: every eval, host and environment route addresses servers that were created here. Names are unique per workspace, so a
clash responds `409` rather than silently returning the existing row. Secret-bear…\n- [List a server's revisions](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A saved server's stored revisions, newest first. A revision is a capt
ure of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever they change on a connect, an eval run or a chat session. Reads stored
data and never connects to the server, so it works for stdio servers too. A server the caller cannot…\n- [Get one server revision
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-server-revision.md): One stored revision: every tool's definition and the
server info the server reported. `droppedFields` lists paths storage dropped for size; their values are unknown, not absent.\n- [D
iff two server revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/diff-two-server-revisions.md): Compares `from` (default: t
he revision before) with `revisionNumber`: tools added and removed with their definitions, tools changed with the fields that move
d and both definitions, and each changed server info field with both values. Revision 1 has nothing before it, so diffing it needs
`from`. A fi…\n- [Get one saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-saved-server.md): The server's deta
il, projected toward the hosted shape. Secrets are never included — `hasClientSecret` reports presence only. A server id from anot
her project reads as `404`.\n- [Delete a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/delete-a-saved-server.md): So
ft-deletes the server and schedules its cascade: MCP Apps views, hosted OAuth credentials, encrypted secret objects, and a rotatio
n of every host config that referenced it. The cascade is ASYNCHRONOUS, so a read immediately after this call may still observe th
e row. The request body must be empty.\n- [Update a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/update-a-saved-ser
ver.md): Sparse update: omitted fields are unchanged. Renaming re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`409` on a clash). Editing a se
rver shared as an OAuth connection requires project admin. `clientSecret` and `clearClientSecret` are mutually exclusive.\n- [List
a project's server groups](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-server-groups.md): A server group i
s an immutable snapshot of a set of saved servers. Pinning one on an environment is what keeps a run off its host's live server li
st, so a composed run keeps testing the servers it was composed against even after the shared host is edited.\n- [Snapshot servers
into a server group](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/snapshot-servers-into-a-server-group.md): Creates a serve
r group holding exactly the given servers and responds `201` with its detail. Groups are create-only — there is no update route, b
ecause an editable group would reintroduce the drift that pinning exists to prevent. Names are unique per project, so a clash resp
onds `409`. Servers must…\n- [List a project's environments](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-en
vironments.md): The project environments saved in the project. Archived environments are excluded unless `includeArchived=true` —
you need that to find one to restore.\n- [Create an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/create-an-envi
ronment.md): Create a project environment from a host plus, optionally, a standalone server group, a pinned skill selection, and p
inned plugin versions. The name must be unique among the project's live environments. Requires project admin.\n- [Check what this
deployment's environment surface supports](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/check-what-this-deployments-environm
ent-surface-supports.md): Report which environment features this MCPJam deployment accepts. Call it before sending a model overrid
e: clients ship independently of the platform, and a field an older deployment does not know is a hard validation error there rath
er than a silently ignored one. A deployment too old to answer rep…\n- [Show one environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/environments/show-one-environment.md): Read one environment, including the `revision` you pass back as `expectedRevision` when w
riting to it.\n- [Update an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/update-an-environment.md): Edit an env
ironment. Only the fields you send change; send `null` for `serverAttachmentId`, `skillSelection`, or `pluginVersionIds` to clear
them. Requires `expectedRevision` — the revision you last read. If the environment changed since, the write is rejected with 409 r
ather than overwriting the co…\n- [Preview what an environment resolves to](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/pre
